stem: A powered tool has visible cord damage near a wet harvest area. What is the strongest response?
choices: Open the tool and inspect wiring
Stop use, prevent exposure where authorized and escalate for qualified repair
Dry the floor and keep using it
rationale: Stop use, prevent exposure where authorized and escalate for qualified repair. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
